findings.title: Exact artifact integrity and procedural isolation verified
findings.finding: The outer ZIP SHA256 and 177,700-byte size match foundation-58.json. The template source-manifest hash matches, and all 19 pinned file hashes were verified before and after review. Imports of power/governance/policy/pit/models resolved only inside the extracted packet. The row schema rejects real target/feature columns. Git revision/source-export claims were reviewed as manifest provenance rather than independently rederived against Git/raw archives.

findings.title: Model, causal folds, training weights and score budget match
findings.finding: The source implements alpha=1 on weighted mean loss, training-only weighted standardization and two unpenalized direction intercepts. An independently formulated solver eliminates intercepts before solving residualized slopes: 180 fits matched, maximum absolute difference 6.106226635438361e-16. For 15 seeded trials covering every DGP, zero/medium/high signal and both missingness assumptions, independent reconstruction matches maturity/14d embargo, annual training/test masks, prefix-only admitted training components, readiness, training terciles, equal-spaced 75th-percentile thresholds, B0 fourth-event offset, and chronological caps.

findings.title: Cluster bootstrap retains duplicate replicas and undefined tails
findings.finding: Explicit reconstruction of 2,000 7d and 2,000 14d draws on a heterogeneous nested-component fixture assigns distinct replica IDs before recomputing 7d component weights. Correlation, paired MSE skill and per-alert means match the aggregated implementation. The fixed seed and shared metric/model draw identities are retained. Undefined statistics are placed at negative infinity and >5% undefined fails inference. At 3-5% undefined the lower-tail placement itself can correctly fail a positive lower-bound gate; undefined values are not discarded.

findings.title: All mechanical gates and FULL PASS conjunction independently audited
findings.finding: Independent scalar/explicit-weight recomputation matches all 12 reported flags for 15 synthetic trials under all three economic drifts. This covers both bootstrap lower bounds, spaced/fold consistency, frozen score monotonicity, alert minima, mean economics and Tier A/B0 comparison, the adversity proxy, three leave-year-out checks, removal of five influence-ranked 14d components, and positive-contribution concentration. Every readiness and inferential gate enters full_pass. The version without adversity omits only adversity, so it is an upper bound under the remaining synthetic premises.

findings.title: Oracle strength, economic drift, missingness and path assumptions remain distinct
findings.finding: The independent/14d-cluster Gaussian, unit-variance t(3), UP-stronger and DOWN-stronger designs, fixed PCG64 seeds, Gaussian common-factor features, balanced Tier-A/Tier-B coefficient packet and exogenous 0/10% missingness are explicit assumptions. Nominal r is oracle signal strength, not fitted OOS r or a unique tradable-return expectation. Adding constant normalized drift is compatible with the normalized target: unpenalized intercepts translate forecasts and thresholds by that same drift without changing information metrics or selections; independent refits verify this. Economics uses furnished causal S and the proposed 0.004 cost. Hourly unit-S Brownian bridges cannot establish real high/low MAE or intrahour extremes.

findings.title: Annual cap and concentration warning are valid conditional constraints
findings.finding: Independent structural reconstruction gives 354 candidates, 107 global cooldown identities, 128 7d and 47 14d components. Training counts are 91/143/216, spaced training 29/46/65, and trailing-12m spaced training 16/17/18. Thus caps are 4+4+4, at most 12 alerts, reduced by missingness. With K positive components, the five largest have at least min(1,5/K) of positive contributions, so K>=9 is necessary for <=60%; eight equal components give 62.5%, nine give 55.56%. Nine is not sufficient, and this is not a universal impossibility proof over all DGPs.

findings.title: Full synthetic evidence reproduces exactly with qualified uncertainty
findings.finding: Full independent reproduction covers 80 regimes, 160,000 synthetic experiments, 240 economic rows and 2,000 bootstrap draws under each component definition. surface.json and surface.csv are byte-identical; geometry is unchanged. Original CSV/JSON identifiers, budgets, every gate probability and label match. All full-pass and full-pass-without-adversity counts are zero. Per-regime 0/2,000 Wilson upper bound is 0.001917047281252934 (0.1917%); this is conditional Monte Carlo uncertainty, not real MOM-002 power or FAIL. At r=0 primary/incremental maxima are 1.70%/0.10%; economics reaches 4.70% including positive drift versus 1.15% at zero drift. Positive-drift economics is not a zero-return null. Common random numbers couple regimes; pooling them as independent trials would be invalid.

findings.title: Binding-gate labels include ties rather than uniquely identified minima
findings.finding: Concentration has zero passes in all 240 rows. In 18 rows incremental information also has zero passes, so min(GATES[:10]) labels it by enumeration order, not because a uniquely binding bottleneck was identified. Labels total 222 concentration and 18 incremental information. Interpret the latter as tied minima. This does not affect the full-pass result or the accepted conditional conclusion. Preserve pinned originals and publish this current interpretation separately.

findings.title: Accepted conclusion does not resolve real readiness or human values
findings.finding: The defensible conclusion is INDETERMINATE_ASSUMPTIONS_REQUIRED with a severe conditional feasibility warning. Complete-case/common-coverage and exogenous missingness are premises, not authentic historical source/PIT or exact six-feature readiness acceptance. This review does not accept #51, choose minimum worthwhile effect, approve 40bp appropriateness or decide terminal versus descriptive economics. It changes no gate, consumes no predictive trial and admits/scores/passes/fails no real experiment.

Fixed bootstrap draws and common random numbers couple regimes. Per-regime Wilson intervals are not simultaneous familywise bounds; regimes must not be pooled as independent trials.
